name: Rajbut Ambari — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Rajbut Ambari from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Rajput Ambari" but are not part of the Rajbut Ambari entry, which is unchanged.

hp 88 (16d8+16)
Fort +5, Ref +6, Will +10
Defensive Abilities undead traits; DR 10/bludgeoning

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee gore +20 (2d8+10), slam +20 (2d6+10)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks trample (2d8+15, DC 28), war stomp

TACTICS

During Combat Rajput ambaris immediately attack anyone their creator or handler directs them to. They start by trampling the nearest enemy and then use war stomp to knock down foes, following up with slams and gores to finish off opponents.

Morale Rajput ambaris fight until destroyed.
